card.name: Fibrosis and lung-disease drug labels
card.fires_on: Marks inside labels for pirfenidone, nintedanib and riociguat, a family of drugs for lung fibrosis and lung disease. It fires on small pieces such as a space before a study number, 'with', a drug-name fragment, or a section number.
